sources.evidence: 固定HTMLの見出し・導入文・貢献度TOP3・TOP10第1行。2026年11月15日の4試合、デクスター・デニス（島根）が貢献度1位、EFF 38、37得点。ファイルのblob SHAを標準SHA-1計算で照合済み（gitコマンド未使用）。

島根スサノオマジック公式のデクスター・デニス選手プロフィール画像を取得して目視。容姿のみ参照し、外部ページの成績は画像内容の根拠にしていない。写真やロゴは完成画像へ貼り付けていない。

brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail for バスケまとめ, as a PNG, 1600×900 pixels, landscape 16:9, no border.

Content basis: the supplied fixed article is about the November 15, 2026 contribution (EFF) rankings across that day's four games. Dexter Dennis of Shimane is #1 with EFF 38 and scored 37 points. Do not confuse EFF 38 with 38 points.

Style: approved editorial sports artwork, deep near-black #151A18 background, acidic lime #CCF43B dry-brush sweeps, warm ivory large bold Japanese typography. Bold hand-drawn black ink contours, brush shading, rough paper grain, limited shapes, forceful composition. Clearly an illustration, never photographic or a photo collage. A few orange accents only on the ball. Match the expressive black/lime visual language of the viewed approved reference, but not its player, score, old date, or shooting pose.

Subject: ONE real basketball player, Dexter Dennis (デクスター・デニス), article's primary subject, drawn from the observed official Shimane portrait for likeness. Recognizable traits: short upright black twisted/coiled hair with subtle brown tips, closely faded sides; angular broad jaw and chin, prominent cheekbones, straight thick eyebrows, focused dark eyes, broad nose, full lips, close trimmed mustache and chin goatee with light jawline stubble, muscular long arms with loose tattoo-like ink shading. Face must stay readable with ivory highlights and distinct eyes/nose/mouth, not a black silhouette. Draw him in a new dynamic basketball drive/gather pose, three-quarter face, bending forward at the waist with strong diagonal movement, controlling an orange basketball at the hip with naturally formed hands. Show head, torso, arms and upper legs. Keep the face, ball and both hands fully inside the canvas. The action is a symbolic editorial illustration, not recreation of an actual play from the game. No other people.
Clothing: plain unbranded sleeveless basketball uniform in charcoal/ivory with a very small blue edge accent, no logos, no sponsor text, no team wordmarks, no jersey numbers, no league marks. No photographic pixels or parts pasted from the official source.

Composition: text occupies the left 57%, athlete the right 43%, with diagonal lime brush strokes behind him. Keep high contrast and compact information density. The main numeric EFF 38 is the largest visual text. Keep at least 55px safe margin around all text. Bottom annotation in clearly legible small ivory type on clean dark background, not hidden by brushwork. Typography must be accurate Japanese, heavy sans-serif with a slight dry-brush texture for big numerals.

Render ONLY these exact text lines, in this hierarchy:
Small top-left: "2026.11.15｜4試合"
Large left headline: "貢献度1位"
Largest left numeric headline: "EFF 38"
Medium large left player name: "デクスター・デニス"
Medium left subline: "島根｜37得点"
Bottom left: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Bottom underneath or adjacent, fully readable: "成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Do not add any other text, badge, logo, fake brand, scoreboard, opponent, ranking season claim, nationality ranking, game-winning-shot claim or trophy. No copied official photo. No duplicated ball, extra limbs, malformed fingers, cropped head, cropped ball, or obscured annotation. The only performance figures shown must be EFF 38 and 37 points, and the date/scope text must be exact.
